projects.title: Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn PS3 Simplified Chinese Patch
projects.platform: PlayStation 3 (Japan disc BLJS-10154; PS3 release patch, RPCS3 usage documented)
projects.status: Released; the project README links a 2026-10-07 cumulative update (v2026.10.07-cumulative.2) over the 2026-09-19 translation base. The maintainer reports Apple-silicon Mac/RPCS3 confirmation, while Windows/Linux and PS3-hardware compatibility are not established; full in-game text/visual review is still incomplete.
projects.summary: Japanese → Simplified Chinese patch for the Japanese PlayStation 3 game BLJS-10154 / BLJS10154. The maintainer documents text for the story, mission communications, menus, names, tutorials, chapters, and supported DLC. The patch requires the user’s own matching game and optional DLC. A custom license permits personal noncommercial use and sharing the repository link, but prohibits redistributing patch files or repackaging them.
projects.strategy: Fan translation patch (resource deltas with installer and restore support)
projects.source_available: Public patch releases and installer source; the game is not included. Repository LICENSE is a custom noncommercial-use/no-patch-redistribution license, not an open-source license.
projects.programming_language_status: GitHub Languages API exact byte map is staged separately; Python is the largest measured code category. This does not describe the Japanese → Simplified Chinese translation direction.

The project has a custom restrictive license: link sharing is allowed, patch-file redistribution and repackaging are prohibited.

projects.summary: Japanese → English partial texture-text patch for the Japan-only Windows PC release The Typing of the Dead II. Repository README and LICENSE specify MIT.

The project also bundles non-localization fixes (font outlines and a dgVoodoo2 wrapper installer); the localization remains a game-specific language patch.
